channel.title: The Grant Desk - Artist Residencies, Media Arts, Film & Sound, Africa, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Artist Residencies, Media Arts, Film & Sound, Africa, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant, instead of trickling out daily. Each Sunday's drop carries every grant added that week, except any closing on the drop day itself.

item.title: Playful Obscura 2027: Arthouse Games Residency Africa (Addis Ababa, Goethe-Institut and A MAZE.)
item.description: Goethe-Institut Addis Abeba, with Creative HUB Ethiopia, A MAZE., British Council and Alliance Ethio-Francaise · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · Three-week funded residency hosting two artists at a time. 2027 financial terms were not published in the call excerpt we could verify; the 2026 Accra edition provided accommodation, a production budget of up to EUR 1,000 and a EUR 300 stipend. No application fee.

item.title: Delfina Foundation x Calouste Gulbenkian Foundation: Open Call for Artists from Portugal and Portuguese-Speaking African Nations (London residency)
item.description: Delfina Foundation, in partnership with the Calouste Gulbenkian Foundation (UK Branch) · deadline 04 Oct 2026 · Twelve-week fully funded residency: a return economy-class flight, airport transfers in the UK, reimbursement of visa fees if required, a living allowance of GBP 40 per day, a materials budget of GBP 1,200, a travel pass for London's public transport network, and a single bedroom with a desk at Delfina Foundation, a house hosting up to eight residents with shared bathrooms, laundry rooms, kitchen, library and dining room. No application fee.

item.title: 1 new Media Arts, Film & Sound residency - week of 17 Aug 2026
item.description:
• University of Johannesburg Artists in Residence 2027
    https://arts.uj.ac.za/artists-in-residence/
    UJ Arts & Culture, University of Johannesburg · deadline 31 Aug 2026 · Stipend of ZAR 12,000 per month across a 10-month residency, so roughly ZAR 120,000 in total. No travel or accommodation budget on top of the stipend, and studio or rehearsal space is limited rather than guaranteed. No application fee.
